items.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: He has a group that I used to play with on occasion, it’s called Class, it’s himself and a rhythm section and three or four violinists, female violinists.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. He’s not out as much you know. But he’s playing. He has a group that I used to play with on occasion, it’s called Class, it’s himself and a rhythm section and three or four violinists, female violinists. I don’t know that that has anything to do with it but it probably does.
Let’s put it this way, it’s not a negative in selling it.
